auftrag: Three people tell Agent Wren what they did on Monday. Listen carefully. Then solve five puzzles.

saetze: On Monday I left the Academy at six thirty and had a coffee with a friend.
At eight o'clock I came back because I forgot my glasses.
In the corridor on the second floor I saw Mr Hale.
He was carrying a bag and he looked nervous.
On Monday I closed the café at nine and cleaned the kitchen.
At ten o'clock a tall man in gloves came in.
He asked me to keep a small parcel in the locker.
I did not see his face.
On Monday I finished work at six and went home.
I cooked dinner, watched TV and went to bed early.
I did not come back to the Academy.
Somebody stole the compass, wrapped it in a green cloth and ran away.

raetsel.frage: Who says what? Put each sentence with the right person.

aussagen.text: A tall man gave me a parcel.
I did not come back to the Academy.
I saw Mr Hale on the second floor.

raetsel.hilfe1: Read the three statements again. Who says "I"?
raetsel.hilfe2: Dr Cole is at the Academy. Sam is at the café. Mr Hale is at home.

raetsel.frage: Two of these sentences cannot both be true. Which two?
optionen: Sam closed the café at nine.
Mr Hale did not come back to the Academy.
Dr Cole saw Mr Hale at the Academy at eight.
raetsel.hilfe1: Look for two statements about the same place and the same evening.
raetsel.hilfe2: Dr Cole says she saw Mr Hale. Mr Hale says he was not there.

raetsel.frage: When did the tall man come into the café?
raetsel.hilfe2: Sam closed the café at nine. The man came later.

raetsel.frage: True or false? “Dr Cole left the Academy at eight o'clock.”
raetsel.hilfe1: Read the first sentence of Dr Cole's statement.
raetsel.hilfe2: She LEFT at six thirty. At eight she CAME BACK.
raetsel.rtyp: True, false or not in the text

raetsel.frage: Mr Hale tells his story. Choose the right words.
raetsel.text: On Monday I ___ work at six and ___ home. I ___ dinner, ___ TV and ___ to bed early.
raetsel.hilfe1: Mr Hale tells about Monday. Monday is over.
